category: ⚡ 1. Speed Limits, Braking Physics & Following Buffers

items.label: Urban Unmarked Road Speed Limit
items.value: 50 km/h

items.label: Slow Lane & Undivided Alley Speed Limit
items.value: 40 km/h

items.label: Railroad Crossing Approach Speed Limit
items.value: 15 km/h or less (Stop if red light flashes)

items.label: Braking Distance Physics
items.value: Braking distance ∝ Speed² (2x speed = 4x longer stopping distance)

items.label: Reaction Time Distance Physics
items.value: Reaction distance increases directly in linear proportion to speed

items.label: Turn Signal Advance Distance
items.value: Activate turn signal at least 30 meters before turning or lane change

items.label: Pedestrian Crosswalk Yielding Buffer
items.value: Yield at least 3 meters (approx. 4 zebra stripes) before crosswalk

items.label: Prohibited Stopping Zone Distance
items.value: Prohibited within 10 meters of intersections, bus stops, fire hydrants

items.label: Cargo Rear Extension Limit
items.value: Max 50 cm beyond rear wheel axle

items.label: Cargo Width Extension Limit
items.value: Max 10 cm beyond outer edges of handlebars

items.label: Cargo Height Limit (Small Light Motorcycle)
items.value: Not exceeding rider shoulders; max 1.5 meters from ground

items.label: Cargo Height Limit (Regular / Heavy Motorcycle)
items.value: Not exceeding rider shoulders; max 2.5 meters from ground

items.label: Small Light Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Max 30 kg

items.label: Regular Light Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Max 60 kg

items.label: Heavy Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Max 90 kg

items.label: Passenger Carrying Regulations
items.value: Allowed ONLY on rear passenger seat of 50cc+ motorcycles

items.label: Carrying Children on Front Footrest / Floorboard
items.value: Strictly illegal (fines NT$300 to NT$600)

items.label: Small Electric Bicycles (Micro-Mobility)
items.value: Carrying any passenger is strictly prohibited

category: 🪖 3. Helmet Laws, Driver Licenses & Traffic Fines

items.label: Helmet Certification & Fastening Law
items.value: Must wear BSMI/CNS approved helmet with chin strap securely fastened (NT$500 fine if unfastened)

items.label: Running a Red Light (Motorcycle)
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Operating Handheld Mobile Phone While Riding
items.value: NT$1,000 fine for operating handheld device while riding

items.label: Smoking Cigarette While Riding
items.value: NT$1,200 fine if affecting the safety/comfort of others

items.label: Riding Motorcycle in Opposite Direction (Wrong Way)
items.value: NT$600 to NT$1,800 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Failing to Yield to Pedestrians on Crosswalk
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Failing to Yield to Emergency Sirens (Ambulance)
items.value: NT$3,600 fine + Mandatory driver license revocation

items.label: Demerit Points Suspension Cap
items.value: Accumulating 12 demerit points in 1 year = 2 months license suspension

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.03% blood alcohol)

items.label: Criminal Offense Prosecution BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.25 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.05% blood alcohol)

items.label: Motorcycle Drunk Riding Fine (First Offense)
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 + License suspension for 1 to 2 years

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Breathalyzer Test Penalty
items.value: NT$180,000 fine + Instant license revocation + Vehicle impoundment

items.label: Second Refusal to Sobriety Test (within 10 yrs)
items.value: NT$360,000 fine + Instant revocation + Public disclosure

items.label: Repeat Drunk Riding Window (10 Years)
items.value: Max fine + License revocation + Public photo/name disclosure

items.label: Passenger Riding with Drunk Rider Penalty
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 fine for passengers 18+ (except seniors 70+)

items.label: When Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook Turn) is Mandatory
items.value: 1. Roads with 3+ lanes in same direction | 2. Where two-stage left turn sign is posted

items.label: Two-Stage Left Turn Proper Protocol
items.value: Ride straight into waiting box on far right, turn left in box, wait for green light

items.label: Turning Left Directly on Multi-Lane Roads
items.value: Strictly illegal (fine NT$600–1,800 + severe t-bone collision risk)

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way: Straight vs Turning
items.value: Straight-going motorcycle has priority over turning vehicles

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way: Left vs Right Turn
items.value: Left-turning vehicle MUST yield to Right-turning vehicle

items.label: Roundabout Right-of-Way
items.value: Entering vehicles MUST yield to vehicles circulating inside roundabout

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Motorcycle)
items.value: 1.0 mm (worn tires cause blowouts and hydroplaning)

items.label: Tire Pressure Check Frequency
items.value: Check weekly when tires are cold

items.label: Brake Lever Free Play Standard
items.value: Free play clearance should be 10 to 20 mm

items.label: Optimal Braking Technique
items.value: Use both front and rear brakes simultaneously (approx. 70% front, 30% rear)

items.label: Riding Over Wet Manhole Covers & Painted Lines
items.value: Keep bike upright, avoid leaning, avoid harsh braking or acceleration

items.label: Large Truck Blind Spots & Inner Wheel Radius (Off-tracking)
items.value: Keep at least 2 meters lateral clearance from turning heavy trucks

items.label: Passing Parked Cars Safely
items.value: Maintain at least 1 meter buffer distance to prevent car door strikes

category: 🚑 7. Accident Response, CPR & First Aid Protocol

items.label: Immediate Crash Action
items.value: Stop immediately, shut off engine, turn on hazard lights, place warning signs

items.label: Removing Injured Rider's Helmet
items.value: Do NOT remove helmet unless breathing is obstructed (prevents neck injury)

items.label: First Aid Medical Priority
items.value: 1. Airway (A) → 2. Bleeding (B) → 3. Fractures (C)

items.label: CPR Ratio (Compressions to Breaths)
items.value: 30 Chest Compressions to 2 Rescue Breaths (30:2)

items.label: CPR Speed and Depth
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute; 5 to 6 cm depth

items.label: Railroad Breakdown SOS 3-Step Action
items.value: 1. Press Red Emergency SOS Button → 2. Push bike clear → 3. Move clear
